source:
26.11 is a visual novel about a group of friends living in a small town, but that does not keep them cooped up at home. One day, something terrible happens. The fate of the friend group will depend entirely on you!

[Translated from [url=https://t.me/sovabalicanon/7]Telegram[/url]]
translation:
《26.11》是一部视觉小说，讲述了一群住在小镇的朋友的故事，但这并不会让他们被关在家里。有一天，发生了一件可怕的事情。好友组的命运将完全取决于你！

[译自[url=https://t.me/sovabalicanon/7]Telegram[/url]]
